key_enforcement: START and FINISH rows must have exactly their registered key sets; extra or missing keys invalidate the ledger.
counting: Every START row counts as one agy process and one inference call, regardless of exit.
finish_guarantee: After START and every spawn attempt, FINISH is appended in a finally path even when invocation capture, capture persistence, envelope parsing, or RAW persistence fails. Available stdout and stderr are preserved best-effort and no retry is permitted.
continuation: Only FINISH rows with process_success and envelope_schema_valid true permit the next registered cell. Membership outcomes and zero candidates do not block.
